description: Hourly cloud cover for the next 1-48 hours at any point, split into total, low, medium and high cloud plus fog, with the clearest hour picked out. For stargazing, astrophotography, aurora or sunset photography, and estimating solar panel output. Source: MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 (percent of sky covered, model forecast). Fog is only given for the first few days. Needs lat and lon: for a UK place name or postcode, get coordinates from geocode or postcode_lookup first. (cost: 1 credit)

hours.description: integer, optional, how many hours ahead from the current hour (1-48), default 24

lat.description: number, required, latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

name: cloud_cover_forecast
